In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''Chadra-Fan''' was one of several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] whom [[Urdruua]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] hired to find and [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] joined the hunt on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where the hunters learned that their target was the former Jedi-turned-[[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. After Urdruua attempted to kill Sing himself and failed, the Chadra-Fan and several [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] bounty hunters cornered her in the streets and attempted to apprehend her. However, Sing defeated the bounty hunters and escaped.

==Biography==
A [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operated<ref name="OS" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Old Scores]]'' takes place three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|breakout]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Urdruua]], who worked out of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], began hiring [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for him, and the Chadra-Fan was one of many bounty hunters who answered the call.<ref name="OS" />

[[File:Chadra_Fan_is_Engaged.png|thumb|left|250px|Aurra Sing disarmed the Chadra-Fan bounty hunter with her cape.]]
The bounty also attracted the former Jedi and bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], who had run afoul of Urdruua sometime prior. Urdruua's scheme was, in fact, a trap for Sing. The Hutt planned to kill Sing with noxious gas inside his throne room located in his palace. Realizing it probably would not work, he additionally positioned the Chadra-Fan and a number of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] bounty hunters out where the gas pipes led into the streets to wait for her, believing that the pipes would be Sing's escape route.<ref name="OS" />

When Sing arrived, she and the Hutt conversed briefly before he attempted to kill her. As he had expected, she escaped through the very pipes that were spilling noxious fumes into the Hutt's chamber. The Chadra-Fan and at least one of the Nikto had since donned [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] to blend in with the street crowds when Sing finally surfaced out of the pipe system. As Sing recovered from the gases, the Chadra-Fan held her at gunpoint. Sing moved fast, using her [[Cape/Legends|cape]] to block the the blast from the Chadra-Fan's [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]] before wrapping the [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] in her [[Clothing/Legends|cape]]. As the Nikto bounty hunters advanced, Sing used the Chadra-Fan as a projectile against the Nikto, knocking them all unconscious. Sing escaped further bounty hunters and eventually killed Urdruua and his [[Unidentified Gran (Nar Shaddaa)|aide]] with a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] she had planted in his throne room.<ref name="OS" />

==Personality and traits==
The Chadra-Fan and the other bounty hunters took on the job of killing a Jedi, believing they could successfully do so. As it turned out, Aurra Sing was more than a handful, and the Chadra-Fan and the others were defeated by the former Jedi. The Chadra-Fan had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], was covered in brown fur, and had pink skin.<ref name="OS" />

==Equipment==
The Chadra-Fan carried a [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] launcher for the encounter with Aurra Sing. The weapon was capable of blasting a hail of small projectiles at once, though the projectiles were weak enough to be stopped by nothing more than a thick cape. The Chadra-Fan wore orange clothing during the encounter with Sing and also used a cape to blend in with the street crowd.<ref name="OS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chadra-Fan was created for the short story ''[[Old Scores]]'', which was one of four stories compiled into the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 8|eighth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series,<ref name="OS" /> published on [[June 20]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/14-334/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Volume-8|text=title=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 8}}</ref> ''Old Scores'' was written by [[Chris Avellone]], illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]], and colored by [[Pamela Rambo]].<ref name="OS" />
